__baseline_prompt__.text: A cinematic photographic investigative-fiction scene centers on a person engaged in an investigation, examining records to test a suspected connection. Use the supplied portrait as the face and hair appearance reference. Preserve the visible facial appearance from the supplied portrait. Preserve the visible short dark bob and wispy fringe from the supplied portrait. The subject is a fictional character. At a quiet charity-fraud investigation desk near closing time, the investigator has found the same receiving account at the end of a diverted-donation trail. A single monitor angled toward the viewer shows three large account tiles connected by successive transfer arrows, ending at a clearly legible A-17 tile with the amount 9,800,000 beneath it. A printed bank statement lies directly below that terminal tile and repeats A-17 and 9,800,000 in large clear type. The investigator's right hand guides a graphite pencil, its point physically touching a freshly drawn circle around A-17 on the printed bank statement; the left fingertips hold the paper's near corner flat. Both hands visibly connect to their own forearms. Their eyes move from the circled entry toward the terminal screen tile, lips slightly parted in concentrated recognition, as the once-disconnected records become one traceable lead. A soft ivory shirt with the sleeves casually turned back and a gentle glow on the cheek lend the subject a quiet personal appeal. Photograph from across the desk at a slightly elevated three-quarter angle, keeping the recognizable face, both hand-to-paper contacts, printed entry and terminal screen tile simultaneously readable. The near paper and monitor occupy a clean shared diagonal; a modest stack of closed case folders recedes into soft shadow. Restrained warm desk light meets cool screen light, with natural skin texture and sufficient depth of field for the investigation to read as a purposeful present action.
